plan.comparisons: market60 vs neutral.5, frozen flow, market1 and market60_unshrunk. Fixed flat probabilities for original all-anchor direction gates. No ability to identify future flats is assumed.
plan.data: Same frozen sources,550362 anchors, five-minute spot target anchor+60sec to anchor+360sec. Futures only determine identical training eligibility and frozen control. No downloads, no protected data.
plan.diagnosis: All63 coefficients and day-weighted training losses; nonflat mean/q95 confidence, confidence minus accuracy and neutral count. No refitting based on scores. Reduced confidence alone cannot establish directional discrimination.
plan.fit: Reuse unchanged scalar fitting code: monthly90day matured nonflat samples, same common futures availability, equal total weight per UTC training day pooled across3assets; mean day-weighted logloss + penalty*beta^2/2; convex derivative root xtol1e-13.63fits, no parameter/horizon search after scores. Upper bound8 is numerical guard.
plan.models: market1 penalty.25; market60_unshrunk penalty0; primary market60 penalty.25. Each has one pooled coefficient beta in[0,8] and probability_up=sigmoid(beta*signal). Beta0 means no support for predeclared reversal. A fixed orientation is an imposed constraint, not evidence of stability.
plan.motivation: The first simple experiment removed common one-minute movement and failed. Inspecting the already explored frozen flow coefficients showed negative average own/other60minute slopes in each year. Test that component alone rather than tune the failed residual model.
plan.primary: General solution requires all9 original unconditional market60 direction gates AND all9 conditional information gates versus neutral, flow and market1. Unshrunk comparison isolates regularization only. Same thresholds: accuracy lower99.444%>50%, Brier/logloss gain lower99.444%>0 against named control AND past frequency,>=5 positive monthly Brier gains,>=100 each direction. Original52% selection gate unchanged.
plan.protected: No market data/outcomes from2026-08-01 onward. Preserve all older frozen artifacts and user files. Previously admitted final targets afterJul31 only in2024/25 are unchanged.
plan.purpose: Test one common-hour reversal coefficient after the one-minute relative hypothesis failed. This follow-up is explicitly informed by earlier results, not an independent confirmation.
plan.signals: market1=-clip((own_return1+2*other_return1)/3,-3,3); market60 uses own_return60/other_return60 likewise. These are frozen normalized log returns: own60=(logprice-now minus60minutes ago)/(past60min RMS*sqrt(60)), clipped+-8 before averaging; other is mean of other two normalized returns. All spot information closes through anchor. No fitted normalization, intercept, asset ID or regimes.
plan.status: Retrospective Jan-Jul2024/2025/2026 BTC/ETH/SOL. Prior outcomes/model coefficients informed hypothesis; no pristine or prospective validation claim.
plan.uncertainty: 4000 paired7day blocks seed271032, nine-cohort correction per endpoint; not a joint correction over endpoints, comparisons or sequential research history. No costs/trading/prospective claim.
